safi-cedvel:38-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (لا) redundant (zāʾida) [Note: Or it is the lā of generic negation (lā al-nāfiya li-l-jins), what it negates being implied (muqaddar), i.e. there is no rejecting their denial of the resurrection; then the oath begins anew.], (بما) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقسم), the returning pronoun being omitted; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) the second is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ما; (لا) negative; (اللام) in the position of the lām of the oath; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative, operating like laysa; (قول) genitive in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, khabar (predicate) of ما; (قليلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), being its adjective; (ما) redundant, to emphasise the paucity ...
The clause «لا أقسم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تبصرون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative.
The clause «لا تبصرون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «إنّه لقول ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of the oath. The clause «ما هو بقول ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer of the oath. The clause «تؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
42-43 (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant, to emphasise the negation; (بقول) like the first, and conjoined to it; (قليلا ما) like the first; (تذكّرون) imperfect verb from which one of the two tāʾs has been omitted; (تنزيل) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو"; (من ربّ) attached to (تنزيل) ...
The clause «تذكّرون» has no grammatical position: a second parenthesis.
The clause «(هو) تنزيل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
44-47 (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (لو) a non-jussivising conditional particle; (علينا) attached to (تقوّل); (بعض) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (اللام) occurring in the answer of لو; (منه) attached to (أخذنا) by its being made to include the meaning of «نلنا»; (باليمين) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of أخذنا [Note: I.e. We would seize him while being strong; اليمين is used metaphorically for strength.]; (ثمّ) conjunction; (لقطعنا) like لأخذنا; (منه) attached to (قطعنا) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of الوتين.]; (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) negative, operating like laysa; (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of أحد; (أحد) genitive in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the noun of ما; (عنه) attached to (حاجزين), the khabar of ما, and this is with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «عن عقابه» [Note: The pronoun in (عنه) refers to the Prophet ﷺ.] ...
The clause «تقوّل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer of the oath [Note: Or it is resumptive.].
The clause «أخذنا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivising condition.
The clause «قطعنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ما منكم من أحد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
48-51 (الواو) conjunction in the four places [Note: Or the first is resumptive and the other three are conjunctions.]; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis, in the four places; (للمتّقين) attached to (تذكرة); (منكم) attached to the khabar of أنّ; (على الكافرين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (حسرة) ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ منكم مكذّبين) is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of نعلم.
The clause «إنّه لتذكرة ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the answer of the oath [Note: Or it is resumptive, and the following clauses are conjoined to it.].
The clause «إنّا لنعلم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّه لتذكرة.
The clause «نعلم ...» is in the position of a nominative, khabar of إنّ. The clause «إنّه لحسرة ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّه لتذكرة.
The clause «إنّه لحق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّه لتذكرة.
52- (الفاء) linking to the answer of an implied condition; (باسم) attached to (سبّح) [Note: Or the bāʾ is redundant and اسم is accusative in position, a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is سبّح.] ...
The clause «سبّح ...» is in the position of the answer of an implied condition.

* Morphology:
(الوتين): a noun for a vein in the heart through which blood runs to the whole body; its pattern is فعيل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:1-8.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as a second mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the second (الحاقّة).
The clause «الحاقّة ما الحاقّة» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «ما الحاقّة ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the first mubtadaʾ (الحاقّة).
3- (الواو) conjunction; (ما) like the first, its khabar being the clause أدراك; (ما الحاقّة) like the first, repeated for magnification and exaltation.
The clause «ما أدراك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the initial clause.
The clause «أدراك ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (ما).
The clause «ما الحاقّة ...» is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أدراك.
4- (الواو) conjunction; (بالقارعة) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبت).
The clause «كذّبت ثمود ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), to establish the states of al-Ḥāqqa.
5- 6 (الفاء) a conjunction of consequence (tafrīʿiyya); (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing; the second (الفاء) linking the apodosis of أمّا; (الواو) in (أهلكوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (بالطاغية) attached to (أهلكوا), and (الباء) is causal ...; (بريح) attached to the second (أهلكوا) ...
The clause «ثمود ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كذّبت ثمود ...
The clause «أهلكوا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ثمود) [Note: The basis of this clause: whatever the case may be, Thamūd were destroyed by the overwhelming blast.].
The clause «أمّا عاد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أمّا ثمود ...
The clause «أهلكوا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عاد).
7- (عليهم) attached to (سخّرها); (سبع) an accusative adverb, attached to (سخّرها); (حسوما) a naʿt (adjective) of سبع and ثمانية [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of سخّرها ... and if الحسوم is taken to be a maṣdar — like الشكور with ḍamma on the shīn — it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).]; (الفاء) resumptive; (فيها) attached to (ترى); (صرعى) an accusative ḥāl, the sign of the accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa.
The clause «سخّرها ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of ريح [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of ريح, because it has become specified by the description ... it may also be resumptive.].
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كأنّهم أعجاز ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of القوم.
8- (الفاء) conjunction; (هل) an interrogative particle — and it may convey negation; (لهم) attached to a ḥāl of باقية; (باقية) genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi [Note: It is a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun ... and the tāʾ may be for intensiveness.] ...
The clause «هل ترى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ترى القوم.

* Morphology:
(1) الحاقّة: active participle of the triliteral حقّ, to which the tāʾ of the feminine was added because a feminine is described by it, i.e. the Resurrection that is inevitable, or the Hour that is inevitable, or the state in which matters become binding and their reality is known. Its pattern is فاعلة.
(3) أدراك: it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is أدري — with a yāʾ at its end; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed into alif.
(5) الطاغية: active participle of the triliteral طغى, as in "the thing exceeded (طغى) its limit"; it is a description standing in for the described noun, i.e. the transgressing shout or the transgressing deed. Its pattern is فاعلة ... It was said that it is a maṣdar, and (التاء) is for intensiveness, as in الداهية; and it may be meant as the one who hamstrung the she-camel, who was called طاغية just as one says "so-and-so is a راوية (great narrator)" or "a داهية (cunning one)".
(6) عاتية: feminine of عات, active participle of the triliteral عتا يعتو. Its pattern is فاع; its lām was deleted because it is a manqūṣ (noun ending in -ī) ...
(7) سبع: it came masculine because the thing counted is feminine, namely ليال ... see verse (23) of Sūrat al-Kahf.
(ثمانية): it came feminine because the thing counted is masculine, namely أيام ... a noun of number. Its pattern is فعاللة.
(حسوما): plural of حاسم, active participle of حسم, meaning to follow up an action time after time, especially a complete succession. Some made it a maṣdar meaning severance or extirpation. Its pattern is فعول with two ḍammas.
(صرعى): plural of صريع, a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the passive صرع; it is فعيل in the sense of مفعول, like قتيل and قتلى. The pattern of صرعى is فعلى with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
(1) The meaning of the interrogative: in His words «مَا الْحَاقَّةُ».
I.e.: what thing has made you know what it is? — as an emphasis of its terror and awfulness, by showing that it lies outside the circle of the knowledge of created beings, meaning that its affair is so great, and the extent of its terror and severity such, that hardly anyone's understanding or imagination can reach it. [Translator's note: the source prints «ولا دهمه»; «ولا وهمه» ("nor his imagination") appears intended and is translated.] However you estimate its state, it is beyond that, and greater, and greater still.
The overt noun has been put in the place of the pronoun, for He did not say: ما هي. The benefit of this is an increase in the terror and the magnification of its affair.
2- Al-majāz al-mursal (non-metaphorical figure): in His words «وَثَمانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُوماً».
حسوما is the plural of حاسم, like شهود the plural of شاهد, from "I cauterised (حسمت) the animal" when you follow up its cauterisation of the ailment time after time until it is cut off (ينحسم). So it is a majāz mursal, by using the restricted — namely الحسم, which is successive cauterisation — for succession in general. And it was said: it is borrowed from الحسم in the sense of cauterisation; the days are likened to the cauteriser, and the wind, because of its connection with them and its blowing in them.
3- The non-specified simile (al-tashbīh al-mursal): in His words «كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجازُ نَخْلٍ خاوِيَةٍ».
He likened them to trunks because of the tallness of their statures, for the wind would cut off their heads as it cuts off the heads of tall palms during those eight days.

safi-cedvel:9-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, and the other two are conjunctions; (من) a relative noun in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فرعون; (قبله) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من; (المؤتفكات) conjoined to فرعون, nominative [Note: This is figurative, or with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. the people of the overturned cities.]; (بالخاطئة) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of جاء and what is conjoined to it.
The clause «جاء فرعون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
10- (الفاء) conjunction; (عصوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, which was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (أخذة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «عصوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أخذهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause عصوا.

* Morphology:
(الخاطئة): a form of relation (nisba), i.e. possessed of error, like تامر and لابن. Its pattern is فاعلة.
(أخذة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral أخذ. Its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:11-12.t:
* I'rab:
(لمّا) an adverb in the sense of "when", containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis حملناكم; (في الجارية) attached to (حملناكم) [Note: I.e. We carried your forefathers ... so the speech has a muḍāf omitted.].
The clause «إنّا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الشرط وفعله وجوابه ...» (the condition, its protasis and its apodosis) is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «طغا الماء ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «حملناكم ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
12- (اللام) of purpose (taʿlīl); (نجعلها) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; (لكم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نجعلها ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (حملناكم).
The clause «نجعلها ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «تعيها أذن ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نجعلها.

* Morphology:
(12) تعيها: it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; the fāʾ was deleted in the imperfect because it is a separated lafīf weak verb (lafīf mafrūq), which is treated like the mithāl in iʿlāl, just as it is treated like the nāqiṣ in the imperative. Its pattern is تعلها.
(واعية): feminine of واع, active participle of the triliteral وعى. Its pattern is فاع, and it contains iʿlāl by deletion: the lām was deleted because it is a manqūṣ (noun ending in -ī). The pattern of واعية is فاعلة.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in His words «إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْماءُ حَمَلْناكُمْ فِي الْجارِيَةِ».
This metaphor is of the type of borrowing the intelligible for the sensible, because of sharing in an intelligible matter; it is the metaphor compounded of the dense and the subtle. The thing borrowed is transgression (al-ṭughā), which is objectionable self-exaltation; the thing borrowed from is every self-exalting, arrogant, tyrannical, harmful one; and the thing borrowed for is the water. Transgression is intelligible, the water is sensible, and the thing borrowed from is sensible.
2- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His words «أُذُنٌ واعِيَةٌ».
He said أذن واعية, in the singular and indefinite, to announce that those who retain are few among them, to rebuke people for the fewness of those among them who retain, and to indicate that a single ear, if it retains and understands from Allah, is the great majority in the sight of Allah, and that no regard is paid to those besides it, even if they fill what lies between east and west

safi-cedvel:13-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (في الصور) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نفخ); (نفخة) a maṣdar standing in place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), because it is qualified.
The clause «نفخ ... نفخة» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
14- 15 (الواو) conjunction in both places, and likewise (الفاء); (دكّة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (يومئذ) an adverb annexed to an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa — because it is annexed to an indeclinable — or accusative as a badal (substitute) of إذا, i.e. attached to (وقعت); and the tanwīn in it is a substitute for an omitted clause, i.e.: on the day when the Trumpet is blown ...
The clause «حملت الأرض ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نفخ.
The clause «دكّتا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause حملت الأرض.
The clause «وقعت الواقعة ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
16- (الواو) conjunction, and likewise (الفاء); the second (يومئذ) attached to (واهية).
The clause «انشقّت السماء ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «هي ... واهية ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause انشقت السماء.
17- 18 (الواو) conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) — and the second is a conjunction; (فوقهم) an accusative adverb, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ثمانية [Note: A naʿt (adjective) placed before what it qualifies. There is disagreement about what ثمانية counts: it was said eight ranks, and it was said eight angels, and it was said eight thousand ... Or it is attached to a ḥāl of عرش ربّك.]; (يومئذ) like the first, attached to (يحمل), and the next one attached to (تعرضون), the pronoun in which is the nāʾib fāʿil; (لا) negative; (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of خافية — a naʿt placed before what it qualifies.
The clause «الملك على أرجائها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause انشقّت السماء [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of السماء.].
The clause «يحمل ثمانية ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause الملك على أرجائها.
The clause «تعرضون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or it is a badal of the apodosis.].
The clause «لا تخفى منكم خافية» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (تعرضون).

* Morphology:
(13) نفخة: a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral نفخ. Its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(14) دكّة: a maṣdar of single occurrence from the triliteral دكّ. Its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(16) واهية: feminine of الواهي, active participle of the triliteral وهي. Its pattern is فاعلة, meaning weak.
(17) أرجاء: plural of رجا, meaning edge and side; in it the wāw was changed into hamza because it came final after a quiescent alif; its original form is أرجاو ... Its pattern is أفعال.
(18) خافية: feminine of الخافي, active participle of the triliteral خفي. Its pattern is فاعلة ... or it is a noun meaning the hidden thing, the opposite of the openly declared ... or it is a maṣdar meaning hiddenness, the opposite of openness, like العافية.

safi-cedvel:19-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive, and the second one linking the apodosis of أمّا; (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing; (بيمينه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوتي), and (الباء) is instrumental (li-l-istiʿāna); (هاؤم) a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "take", its fāʿil (agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as أنتم; (كتابيه) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) governed by اقرؤوا [Note: It is also the object of (هاؤم) by way of contention (tanāzuʿ), and the pronoun of the book has been implied in it.], accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and (الهاء) is the hāʾ of pausing (hāʾ al-sakt), having no grammatical position ... [Translator's note: the source prints «المقدّة», a misprint for «المقدّرة» ("implied"), which is translated.]
The clause «أمّا من أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive ...
The clause «أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (من).
The clause «هاؤم ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اقرؤوا ...» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the clause هاؤم [Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.].
20- (ملاق) the khabar of أنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the deleted yāʾ, for it is a manqūṣ noun (ending in -ī); (حسابيه) mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ملاق, and it is like كتابيه ...
The clause «إنّي ظننت ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «ظننت ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي ملاق ...) is in the position of accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ظنّ.
21- 23 (الفاء) resumptive; (في عيشة) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو); (في جنّة) attached to the omitted khabar [Note: Or attached to عيشة.] ...
The clause «هو في عيشة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قطوفها دانية ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of جنّة.
24- (هنيئا) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of كلوا and اشربوا; (ما) an infinitival particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the referent pronoun omitted.]; (في الأيام) attached to (أسلفتم).
The clause «كلوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech of an implied saying.
The clause «اشربوا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause كلوا.
The clause «أسلفتم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أسفلتم ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (كلوا واشربوا). [Translator's note: the source prints «أسفلتم» here, a misprint for «أسلفتم» of the verse.]
25- (الواو) conjunction; (أمّا من ... فيقول) like the first; (يا) a particle for drawing attention (tanbīh); (كتابيه) like the first [Note: In verse (19) of this sūra.] ...
The clause «أمّا من أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause من أوتي (the first).
The clause «أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «ليتني لم أوت ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech.
The clause «لم أوت ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of ليتني.
26- 27 (الواو) conjunction; (ما) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is (حسابيه), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and (الهاء) is for pausing (li-l-sakt), having no grammatical position; (يا) for drawing attention; and the third-person pronoun in (ليتها) refers to the first death.
The clause «لم أدر ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لم أوت.
The clause «ما حسابيه» is in the position of accusative, filling the place of the two objects of أدر, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative (ما).
The clause «ليتها كانت القاضية» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «كانت القاضية» is in the position of nominative as khabar of ليتها.
28- 29 (ما) negative [Note: Or an interrogative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi.]; (عنّي) attached to (أغنى), and the second one attached to (هلك) by its being made to carry (taḍmīn) the meaning of غاب "has vanished" ...
The clause «ما أغنى عنّي ماليه» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption — or causal (taʿlīliyya). The clause «هلك عنّي سلطانية» has no grammatical position: another explanatory resumption — or another causal explanation.
30- 31 (الفاء) conjunction, and likewise (ثمّ); (الجحيم) a second mafʿūl bihi, fronted ...
The clause «خذوه ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech of an implied saying.
The clause «غلّوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوه.
The clause «صلّوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوه.
32- (ثمّ) conjunction; (في سلسلة) attached to (أسلكوه); (ذراعا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (الفاء) conjunction [Note: For conjoining the reported clauses in the i'rab of the clauses.] ...
The clause «ذرعها سبعون ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of سلسلة.
The clause «أسلكوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to an implied clause after ثمّ [Note: The implied clause is conjoined to the clause (صلّوه) by (ثمّ), i.e. then increase his punishment, so insert him into a chain ...].
33- 34 (لا) negative; (بالله) attached to the negated (يؤمن); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (على طعام) attached to (يحضّ).
The clause «إنّه كان ...» has no grammatical position: causal — or an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كان لا يؤمن ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «لا يؤمن بالله ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كان.
The clause «لا يحضّ ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لا يؤمن.
35- 37 (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (له) attached to an omitted khabar of ليس [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of حميم, the adverb (هاهنا) being the khabar of ليس.]; (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to a ḥāl of حميم, and likewise (هاهنا) [Note: Or (هاهنا) is the khabar of ليس.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (طعام) conjoined to حميم, nominative; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (من غسلين) attached to a naʿt of طعام [Note: If الحميم is what is drunk, or the pus of the Fire that heats the body, then (من غسلين) is, according to the apparent sense, the khabar of ليس.]; (لا) negative; the second (إلّا) is also for restriction.
The clause «ليس له ... حميم ...» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if this was his state in the world, then he has no ... [Note: Or the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ to the causal clause (إنّه كان لا يؤمن ...), and there is a sense of causation in it.].
The clause «لا يأكله إلّا الخاطئون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of غسلين.

* Morphology:
(21) عيشة: a maṣdar known by hearing (samāʿī) of the triliteral عاش, of the class of ضرب. Its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn, so it is on the pattern of the maṣdar of manner (maṣdar al-hayʾa) ... There are other maṣdars of the verb: العيش on the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, معاش on the pattern مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, معيشة on the pattern مفعلة with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and عيشوشة on the pattern فعلولة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(راضية): feminine of الراضي, active participle of the triliteral رضي. Its pattern is فاعلة [Note: It is figurative if it is in its usual sense, i.e. if it is in the sense of the passive participle; and literal if it is in the sense of relation (nisba), like تامر and لابن.].
(23) قطوف: plural of قطف, with kasra then sukūn, its pattern being فعل in the sense of مفعول, like الذّبح in the sense of المذبوح, i.e. the fruit that is picked. The pattern of قطوف is فعول with two ḍammas.
(24) الخالية: feminine of الخالي, active participle of the triliteral خلا يخلو, of the class of نصر. Its pattern is فاعل, and it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its original form is الخالو; the letter before the wāw came with kasra, so it was changed into yāʾ and it became الخالي. The pattern of الخالية is الفاعلة.
(25) أوت: it contains iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is أفع, with ḍamma, then sukūn, then fatḥa.
(26) أدر: it contains iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is أفع, with fatḥa, then sukūn, then kasra.
(31) صلّوه: it contains iʿlāl by deletion, beginning from the imperfect يصلّون — with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the doubled lām. Its original form is يصلّيون — with a yāʾ with ḍamma before the wāw; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and the vowel was transferred to the lām before it — iʿlāl by making quiescent; then the yāʾ was deleted because it came together, quiescent, with the wāw of the plural, and it became يصلّون ... then the iʿlāl was carried over to the imperative صلّوه. Its pattern is فعّوه.
(32) ذرعها: the maṣdar of ذرع meaning "to measure", or a noun meaning length. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(سبعون): a numeral noun among the words for the tens, assimilated to the sound masculine plural. Its pattern is فعلون with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ذراعا): a noun for length or for the well-known limb. Its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(34) طعام: it may be a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb أطعم, in the sense of الإطعام (feeding). Its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ ... see verse (259) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(36) غسلين: a noun for what flows from wounds when they are washed; in the exegesis, it is the pus of the people of the Fire, or a tree that they eat. Its pattern is فعلين, with kasra, then sukūn, then kasra.

* Rhetoric:
Specification (al-takhṣīṣ): in His words «ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُها سَبْعُونَ ذِراعاً فَاسْلُكُوهُ».
Placing the chain before the inserting, like placing Hell before the roasting, is to indicate specification and concern, by mentioning the kinds of things with which he is punished; as though it were said: do not insert him except into this chain, as though it were more horrid than all the other places of oppression in Hell.

* Benefits:
- Inversion (al-qalb):
It occurs most often in poetry. Of it is the saying of Ruʾba:
ومهمه مغبرة أرجاؤه ... كأن لون أرضه سماؤه
(And many a desert whose sides are dusty, as if the colour of its earth were its sky.)
I.e. as if the colour of its sky, because of its dustiness, were the colour of its earth; so he reversed the simile for hyperbole, and omitted the muḍāf.
And ʿUrwa ibn al-Ward said
فديت بنفسه نفسي ومالي ... وما آلوك إلا ما أطيق
(I ransomed with his self my self and my wealth — and I do not withhold from you except what is beyond my power.)
The basis is: فديت بنفسي ومالي نفسه ("I ransomed his self with my self and my wealth"). The meaning of ما آلوك is "I do not withhold from you"; then in the verse it was made to carry the meaning of granting, i.e. I do not grant you except what I am able to.
Of inversion in ordinary speech are «أدخلت القلنسوة في رأسي» ("I put the cap into my head"), «عرضت الناقة على الحوض» ("I presented the she-camel to the trough") and «عرضتها على الماء» ("I presented it to the water"). Of it is His words: «وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَى النَّارِ». And Thaʿlab said concerning His words (ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُها سَبْعُونَ ذِراعاً فَاسْلُكُوهُ): the meaning is "insert a chain into him". And of it is His words (ثُمَّ دَنا فَتَدَلَّى فَكانَ قابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنى): its basis is قابي قوس ("the two lengths of a bow"), so the dual was inverted with the singular. This is good if القاب is explained as what lies between the grip of the bow and its سية (i.e. its tip); and it has two tips, so it has two قابs. A parallel to what has passed in the noble verse is the saying of Ibn al-Aʿrābī:
إذا أحسن ابن العم بعد إساءة ... فلست لشرّي فعله بحمول
(When the cousin does good after doing ill, I am not one to bear the worse of his two deeds.)
I.e. "I am not one to bear the worse of his two deeds" (لشر فعليه). And of inversion is His words: (فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ); the basis is "so you were blind to it". And of it is His words (ما إن مفاتحه لتنوء بالعصبة أولي القوة): the meaning is that the band would be weighed down by them, i.e. would rise with them heavily. The upshot is that this style occurs among the Arabs and in their modes of expression, the Noble Qur'an has come with it, and it gives the meaning strength and beauty. [Translator's note: the source quotes the verse as «ما إن مفاتحه ...»; the muṣḥaf text (al-Qaṣaṣ 28:76) reads «مَا إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُ لَتَنُوأُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ». The source also glosses فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ with "فعميتم عنها" (second person). Both translated as printed.]
